name: Pricing with Trees
description: Price an option by building its hedge on a binomial tree, then let the steps shrink.

lessonNames.l1-up-or-down: A stock that goes up or down
lessonNames.l2-copying-the-option: Copying the option with stock and cash
lessonNames.l6-calibrating: Choosing up and down from volatility
lessonNames.l11-implied-vol: Volatility backed out of a price
lessonNames.l13-rules-of-thumb: Rules of thumb for option prices

lessonObjectives.l1-up-or-down: Set up a one-step binomial model of a stock.
lessonObjectives.l2-copying-the-option: Price an option by building a portfolio with the same payoff.
lessonObjectives.l3-risk-neutral: Derive risk-neutral probabilities and price by discounted expectation.
lessonObjectives.l4-hedge-ratio: Compute delta from a one-step tree and hedge with it.
lessonObjectives.l5-two-steps: Price an option on a two-step tree by backward induction.
lessonObjectives.l6-calibrating: Calibrate the tree’s up and down moves to a volatility.
lessonObjectives.l7-american-on-a-tree: Price an American put by checking early exercise at every node.
lessonObjectives.l8-python-pricer: Write a binomial pricer in Python and test it against hand calculations.
lessonObjectives.l9-tiny-steps: Watch tree prices converge as the number of steps grows.
lessonObjectives.l10-black-scholes: Use the Black-Scholes formula and explain each input.
lessonObjectives.l11-implied-vol: Find implied volatility by solving the pricing formula for it.
lessonObjectives.l12-delta-hedging: Simulate delta hedging and measure its error.
lessonObjectives.l13-rules-of-thumb: Estimate an at-the-money option as about 0.4σ√T times the spot, and check it against Black-Scholes.
lessonObjectives.l14-greeks-by-shape: Sketch delta, gamma, vega and theta against spot and time, and sign them for common positions.
lessonObjectives.l15-digitals: Price a digital as a tight call spread and as $e^{-rT}N(d_2)$.
lessonObjectives.l16-the-smile: Read a smile and say what it implies about the risk-neutral distribution.
lessonObjectives.l17-which-is-cheaper: Rank exotic and vanilla options by price without computing them (Asian, barrier, lookback, American).
lessonObjectives.l18-gamma-and-hedging: Explain a delta-hedged option's P&L as gamma times realised minus implied variance.
